recovery.snapshot_sampling: Days 7, 14, 21, and 28 plus the latest eligible pre-outcome snapshot per building-cycle
recovery.label_definition: Population on the last recorded daily date divided by beginning inventory; used as a capstone proxy for harvest recovery because confirmed harvest status is unavailable
recovery.selection_note: For recovery, the compact Ridge avoids building identity and raw inventory size, has the lowest overall held-out MAE, and is selected when its cycle-balanced MAE is within 10% of the best candidate.
recovery.feature_importance_interpretation: Standardized Ridge coefficients show which inputs the fitted model relies on and whether higher values push its raw estimate up or down. They are associations, not causal effects.

weight.training_source: FARM HARVEST DATA.xlsx + Farm Performance Summary.xlsx (final average weight only)
weight.label_definition: Building-level Ave Live Weight (kg) from Farm Performance Summary.xlsx, used directly as the final-harvest label
weight.selection_note: Select the simplest candidate within 5% of the best cycle-balanced MAE.
weight.feature_importance_interpretation: Formal coefficient importance is not available for the selected formula or baseline model.

day35_weight.label_definition: Observed building average bodyweight recorded on production Day 35
day35_weight.feature_importance_interpretation: Ridge reliance uses absolute standardized coefficients. It shows which inputs most influence the fitted forecast after accounting for other inputs; it is not causal evidence. Correlated growth inputs can share importance or show counterintuitive signs.
day35_weight.historical_remaining_gain_definition: For each checkpoint age, subtract the measured checkpoint weight from the observed Day 35 weight for every eligible historical building-cycle, average those gains, then add that average to the current building's measured weight. During validation, the held-out cycle is excluded from the average.
day35_weight.status: Prototype — current cycle excluded; leave-one-complete-cycle-out validation
